huggingface.title: Hugging Face Hub
huggingface.eyebrow: pull a GGUF model into Ollama
huggingface.subtitle: Search GGUF models on the Hub and request a pull into local Ollama. Only official publishers show up by default — nothing downloads without a second explicit confirmation.

confirmModal.title: Confirm model pull
confirmModal.explanation: The download runs on the server and can take minutes, depending on the model's size. The model comes in ACTIVATED for this workspace as soon as it finishes.

toasts.requestErrorTitle: Could not create the pull request
toasts.confirmConnectionLostTitle: Connection lost during the pull — tracking via status
